# Gear Recovery
## Dissolving gel vials Dissolving vials may only be used: - For gear recovery, groundside and shipside, to destroy lost gear. - To clear lodging spaces. - To clean the hunting preserve. - To destroy any remains of an abomination or aberration. - To destroy any remains of genespliced xenomorphs. - To clear unwanted hide or meat from flayed or butchered bodies.
Any other use is forbidden.
## Planetside gear recovery Planetside gear carriers are [color=#57b339]worthy[/color] prey.
- Gear recovery is not mandatory, but it is encouraged and seen as a priority. - Gear recovery in the FOB or the hive is forbidden. - Yautja body recovery is mandatory and exempt from the FOB and hive clause above, though collateral damage should be avoided.
## Shipside gear recovery Shipside gear carriers, and those actively keeping you from retrieving the gear, are [color=#ff0000]dishonorable[/color] prey.
- When recovering gear shipside, you must be efficient, focus on the recovery, and avoid damaging areas and people uninvolved in it. You are not on the hunt here. - Negotiation is forbidden, though you may issue an ultimatum (such as "give it back or die") if you feel the situation warrants it. If the gear isn't returned, you must reclaim it by force. - Shipside gear recovery is only ever mandatory for bodies. You may choose not to recover gear pieces. - Post-hijack gear recovery is forbidden, unless it was started before the hijack, in which case it must be finished. Yautja body recovery is still mandatory, even after hijack.
